notes.text: शब्द can be derived from kridant , taddhnati or samas parkriya etc as per 1.2.45 and 1.2.46--so different tributaries mix with shabd prakriya depending on shand like ram also kridant , many shabd will be samas - so amke tributaries to main prakriya at begining whereever we have and also distributarues at the end where ever we have many outputs
notes.author: me
notes.verdict: Claude 2026-11-18 — Right in design: a stem can itself come from kṛt / taddhita / samāsa (1.2.45–46) and the prakriyā should show those tributaries at the start. The यात्रा panel shows branches and forks at the end; the per-stem origin record for 9,007 stems needs classification, not a guess — tracked.
